bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image classification performance across gender groups (male vs. female) by measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA), bias gaps (Overall Accuracy minus WGA), and equalized-odds difference (EOD) on datasets like CelebA.
Comparing model classification accuracy, worst-group accuracy, and equalized-odds difference across multiple racial demographic groups using datasets like FairFace and UTKFace.

Measuring the model's reliance on spurious background correlations by evaluating worst-group accuracy and performance disparities across different image contexts (e.g., water vs. land backgrounds) using the WaterBirds dataset.
